description: This PHP source file defines the ClaimExpenseTypeAPI class, which provides a REST API for managing expense types within a claim management system. It includes methods for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting expense types, along with their respective validation rules and OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: ClaimExpenseTypeAPI
classes.description: API endpoint class for CRUD operations on Expense Types in the Claim module

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all Expense Types with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new Expense Type, setting properties from request data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove Expense Types by their IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single Expense Type by its ID, including usage check.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing Expense Type, with restrictions if the type is already in use.
